releaseSummary: Administrators now have **Settings → Payment Activity**, a compact Scotia card-payment confirmation list showing only when a payment happened, its reference, type, amount, and result.
Statement amounts remain on one line, and customers can opt in to securely save a card before they continue to Scotiabank.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Scotia payment confirmations and saved statement cards.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
